name: VTK.js Volume Rendering Configuration
aliases: VTK Volume Rendering with Transfer Functions
definition: A React-based volume rendering application using VTK.js that supports multiple blend modes, scalar opacity transfer functions, and color transfer functions for DICOM image visualization.
summary: VTK.js Volume Rendering Configuration is a React-based method for interactive 3D DICOM visualization that integrates React state management with VTK.js widgets for real-time parameter adjustment.
